dct_title_s: Philippines Tropical Storm Bualoi Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Sep 2025
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Tropical Storm Bualoi Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Sep 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Philippines Tropical Storm Bualoi Floods (Sep 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Mindoro, Philippines, Floods, 27 Sep 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Mindoro, Philippines, Floods, 27 Sep 2025, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** leaflet/EOS-RS_202509_Philippines_Tropical_Storm_Bualoi_Floods **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025)
